findings.body: An unavailable approval produces `isError: true` with `openclaw/resultStatus: "unavailable"`. Materialization preserves this as `details.status: "error"` plus `details.mcpMeta`. When converted back to MCP, metadata takes precedence over that error status, but `unavailable` is absent from the failure list, so the result becomes `isError: false`. Preserve the canonical error independently of the metadata status and include unavailable approvals in the model roundtrip regression cases.
findings.title: Preserve canonical errors when restoring approval metadata

findings.body: The new integration suite is included by `vitest.config.ts` and runs in the Ubuntu `check.yml` job. Its unconditional `mkdtemp('D:/tmp/...')` calls require a workstation-specific parent directory and fail on a fresh Linux checkout. These paths also become relative on Linux, conflicting with the stdio child's different working directory. Derive absolute fixture paths from `tmpdir()` and reuse that root for child environment variables; the local TEMP/TMP configuration already directs Windows temporary output to D:.
findings.title: Use a portable temporary root for SDK integration tests

overall_explanation: Unavailable approval errors can become successful results after model adaptation, and the new integration tests introduce a Linux CI failure. Findings are based on source and installed SDK inspection; no tests were run during this review.
